title: diagnosing a train wreck
system_instruction_addendum: TRAIN WRECK ADDENDUM: A train wreck has three named causes: off-phrase, off-key, off-bpm. State the cause you hear; do not soften it. Listening-only lesson.

tutor_speak.text: a train wreck has three named causes: off-phrase, off-key, off-bpm. you usually hear one before the other two.
off-phrase is kicks fighting different beats; off-key is clashing chords; off-bpm is kicks drifting apart.
listen to the next clip and tap continue once you've named the cause to yourself.

hints.text: the kicks tell you about phrase and tempo. the chords tell you about key.
if the kicks pull apart over a few bars, that is off-bpm.
tap continue when you've named the cause.
